nonSyntheticRealSessionCapture.detail: This gate defines and verifies the redaction workflow. It does not claim that a new non-synthetic user session was captured in this run.

redactionRules.appliesTo: API keys, OAuth tokens, cookies, private keys, authorization headers
redactionRules.reason: Trace reports must never become credential stores.

redactionRules.appliesTo: Provider request IDs, message IDs, run IDs, and raw error correlation IDs
redactionRules.reason: Provider correlation identifiers are unnecessary for product-quality summaries.

redactionRules.appliesTo: Raw prompt text, raw completion text, raw tool observations, and raw provider errors
redactionRules.reason: Quality gates need counts, roles, status transitions, and hashes rather than sensitive payload bodies.

redactionRules.appliesTo: Home directories, profile paths, environment variables, and machine-specific runtime details
redactionRules.reason: Reports should preserve reproducibility without leaking local operator context.
SHA-256 preserves artifact identity while avoiding raw-line publication.

captureWorkflow: Capture non-synthetic user/session traces only after an explicit operator action selects the session and local file path.
Store raw JSONL only under the local reports/orchestra-*.jsonl pattern; do not copy credentials, provider configs, profiles, caches, databases, cookies, or environment files.
Run bun run product:real-trace-evals to produce structured summaries with hashes, counts, roles, models, query sources, and status transitions.
Run bun run product:trace-redaction-policy to scan raw traces for credential and provider-request-id patterns before any report is treated as publishable evidence.
Publish only docs/product-quality summary reports; keep raw provider payloads, raw prompt/completion text, authorization data, and local environment details out of reports.
If any credential or provider request-id pattern is detected, stop the product-quality gate and quarantine the trace outside publishable evidence until the operator resolves it.

claimBoundary: Trace capture redaction policy evidence is local, no-provider, and summary-only. It does not capture a new non-synthetic session, call providers, publish raw traces, or claim release readiness, production readiness, public readiness, external validation, or autonomous reliability.
